institutions: Francis Marion University — public four-year university with 60+ undergraduate and graduate programs; now operates several buildings downtown including the FMU Performing Arts Center.
Florence-Darlington Technical College — two-year college with enrollment over 4,500; runs the Southeastern Institute of Manufacturing and Technology (SiMT) workforce training center.
McLeod Regional Medical Center — flagship hospital of the Florence-headquartered McLeod Health system.
MUSC Health Florence Medical Center — Medical University of South Carolina's hospital presence in the metro, giving Florence two competing hospital systems.
HopeHealth — federally qualified community health center network and one of the county's largest listed employers.
highlights: Downtown Florence is a nationally accredited Main Street program and won the Great American Main Street Award from Main Street America in 2023 — an unusually strong downtown turnaround for a metro this size.
Downtown carries the South Carolina Arts Commission Cultural District designation, one of only about eight such districts statewide.
The cultural core is anchored by the Florence County Museum and its Waters Gallery, the FMU Performing Arts Center, FMU University Place Gallery and the Florence Little Theatre.

The city manages three distinct downtown districts — the National Register historic district, the Irby Street Corridor Overlay District, and the Cultural District — which is where redevelopment incentives are concentrated.
